summary: Today brings a mixed corporate and retail update, driven by significant brand expansion metrics from US Polo Assn and Beco alongside regulatory compliance statements from Bisleri. Key developments are further anchored by Reliance's 1,600-satellite telecom plans and Supreme Court land litigation.

bullets.text: Reliance plans to construct a 1,600-satellite constellation network to compete directly with Elon Musk's Starlink service in India.
Bisleri stated it received no FSSAI notice and confirmed a referral laboratory found bromate levels within prescribed safety limits.
U.S. Polo Assn. announced that its Indian retail operations now contribute 20% to its total global revenue.
Sustainable home care brand Beco aims to expand into over 25,000 general trade stores across India within two to three years.
The Supreme Court stayed the eviction of SASTRA University from government land that it was alleged to have encroached upon.
